verses.gurmukhi: ੨੧ : ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ ਜੀ ਤੋਂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿਗੋਬਿੰਦ
verses.translit_en: 21 : guroo arajan jee to(n) guroo harigobi(n)dh

en.bdb: Guru Hargobind from Guru Arjan Dev

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਖਹੁ ਸੋਗਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਹਰਣ ਭਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: harakhahu sogahu baaharaa haran bharan samarath sara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Beyond pleasures and sorrows he is creator, sustainer and destroyer.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗ ਨਿਰਲੇਪੁ ਰਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: ras kas roop na rekh vich raag ra(n)g niralep raha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: He is away from enjoyments, repulsions, forms and even being amidst festivities, he remains detached and stabilized.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਸਟਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਨ ਛੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: gosaT giaan agocharaa budh bal bachan bibek na chha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Unapproable through discussions, he is beyond the powers of intellect, speech; wisdom and praise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਸੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: gur govi(n)dh govi(n)dh gur harigovi(n)dh sadhaa vigasa(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Accepting Guru,(Arjan Dev) as God and God as Guru, Hargobind (the Guru)remains ever elated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜ ਨੋ ਅਚਰਜ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਮਿਲੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: acharaj no acharaj milai visamaadhai visamaadh mila(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Being full of wonder he is absorbed in the supreme :Wonder and thus being awe inspired he remains immersed in supreme rapture , rapture.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਖੰਡੇ ਧਾਰ ਕਾਰ ਨਿਬਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh maarag chalanaa kha(n)dde dhaar kaar nibaha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Moving on the way of gurmukhs is like treading on the edge of  sword.
Accepting the teachings of the Guru, the disciple adopts  them in his life.
